hints.en: The order is fixed: `WHERE` → `GROUP BY` → `HAVING` → `ORDER BY`.

hints.tr: `ORDER BY` en son çalıştığı için orada takma adı kullanabiliyorsun — `HAVING`'de kullanamadığın hâlde.
hints.en: `ORDER BY` runs last, so you can use the alias there — even though you cannot in `HAVING`.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM products
WHERE stock > 0
GROUP BY category
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY item_count DESC, category;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM products
WHERE stock > 0
GROUP BY category
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY item_count DESC, category;
```

hint.tr: İki ayrı süzme var: satırlar (`WHERE`) ve gruplar (`HAVING`). İkisi de gerekiyor.
hint.en: There are two filters here: one on rows (`WHERE`) and one on groups (`HAVING`). You need both.
